label: ERROR_DEPENDENCE_3: no-flag event independent of local correctness
definition: TruthIndependentFlag ν C F means ν (C ∩ Fᶜ) = ν C · ν Fᶜ: under the local measure, absence of a flag is probabilistically independent of local correctness. Such a check carries no discriminating information about the assertion it checks.
note: Control for #1584 test 3. A check that only re-derives an assertion from the same untested input, or reports a common source again, is one concrete way to have this property; whether a given actual check has it is an empirical/process question (compare the dependence processes in docs/notes/correlated-testimony-1396.md). See docs/notes/preface-connectivity-1584.md.
